description: Client-side script for 'Process Statement Of Accounts' form in ERPNext, handling UI interactions, button actions, data fetching, and form updates.

methods.name: view_properties
methods.description: Sets route options and navigates to customize form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adds buttons for sending emails and downloading statements; handles button actions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form query and date fields.

methods.name: customer_collection
methods.description: Updates collection name label based on selected customer collection.

methods.name: frequency
methods.description: Sets start date based on frequency selection.

methods.name: fetch_customers
methods.description: Fetches customers based on collection and updates the form table.
